Servers can now save up to 31 quiz topics in total, including disabled topics. Creating another topic at the limit returns a localized message explaining how to free a slot. Deleting a topic frees a slot; random quizzes do not consume saved-topic slots.

- Enforce the limit in a serializable transaction and retry conflicting writes, so simultaneous creation requests cannot exceed it.
- Keep existing topics editable, including on servers already above the limit. Do not remove existing topics automatically.
- Update help and limit feedback in all six languages, plus README.
- Add coverage for the last available slot, disabled topics, deletion, duplicate names, server isolation and bounded retries. An isolated PostgreSQL 18 test verifies 12 simultaneous requests for the last slot using synthetic data.

No new database migration or Discord command registration is required when upgrading from v3.3.0. Tests do not use production environment files, secrets or records.
